about: Vague one-line asks with the plugins that would actually help. 'must' is a list of needs; each need is the set of plugins that would satisfy it. 'ok' are picks that help but aren't required. A build-method pick (superpowers, feature-dev) is always ok. Labels were written by the same author as needs.json, so this is in-distribution: it checks the mechanism, not real-world accuracy.
